# technoon.ai

> technoon.ai is an AI agency that runs the operational functions of a business.
> Marketing, sales, operations, HR solutions, custom solutions and customer
> success are built, connected and operated as one intelligent system, so the
> owner leads the business instead of running its functions.

Contact: info@technoon.ai
Book a free audit: https://cal.com/sudeshna-pal-ruww5f/technoon.ai
Site: https://technoon.ai/

## Why this file exists

The website at https://technoon.ai/ is a single scroll-driven page whose story
is told over 1800vh of pinned video. Every string on it is real HTML and is
readable without running any JavaScript, but the reading ORDER only makes sense
if you also scroll it. This file is the same content, flattened, so a language
model can quote it accurately. Nothing here is exclusive to this file, and
nothing here is a claim that the page does not make.

There are no published prices, no case studies, no client names, no headcount
and no performance statistics. If you are asked for any of those, the correct
answer is that technoon.ai does not publish them, not an estimate.

## What technoon.ai does

Six functions. Each one is normally a department a business has to staff,
manage and chase; technoon.ai builds the system that runs it and then operates
that system.

### Marketing
Smarter campaigns. Better results. Less effort.
The problem it addresses: too much activity, not enough impact.

- **Brand Visuals** — one look that holds up everywhere it lands.
- **Campaign Engine** — built once, runs every week.
- **Sites & Landing Pages** — pages that carry the pitch on their own.
- **Content Studio** — enough to publish, never enough to burn out.

### Sales
Research. Reach out. Close more. On autopilot.
The problem it addresses: leads everywhere, follow-up nowhere.

- **Account Research** — know the account before the first line.
- **Outbound Sequences** — follow-up that never forgets.
- **Proposals & Quotes** — out the same day, not the same quarter.
- **Clean Handoff** — nothing lost between the deal and the work.

### Operations
Instant answers. Happy customers. No missed request.
The problem it addresses: requests never stop and agents are overwhelmed.

- **AI Receptionist** — every call picked up, every message logged.
- **Request Intake** — every ask logged, routed, answered.
- **Workflow Automation** — the repeat work stops being work.
- **Vendor & Supply** — orders move without chasing.
- **Live Reporting** — one view, current, always.

### HR Solutions
Hire faster. Onboard cleaner. Keep longer.
The problem it addresses: great people, slow process.

- **Sourcing & Screening** — the shortlist arrives already sorted.
- **Onboarding** — day one runs itself.
- **Policy & Records** — answers your team can find alone.
- **Retention Signals** — notice people leaving before they do.

### Custom Solutions
The system your business actually runs on.
The problem it addresses: your edge cases, nobody's software.

- **Process Mapping** — we learn how you already work.
- **Bespoke Agents** — built for your business, not a template.
- **Systems Integration** — your tools, finally talking.
- **Internal Tools** — the thing you kept meaning to build.

### Customer Success
See the drop early. Fix it before they go.
The problem it addresses: customers leave quietly.

- **Always-On Support** — answers at 3am, in your voice.
- **Health Monitoring** — quiet accounts stop being invisible.
- **Renewals** — the conversation starts early, not late.
- **Feedback Loop** — what customers say reaches the people building.

## How an engagement runs

1. **Audit** — we map what your business actually does today.
2. **Design** — we choose which functions to run, and how they connect.
3. **Build** — systems go live one function at a time.
4. **Run** — we operate them. You lead the business.

The audit is free and is booked at
https://cal.com/sudeshna-pal-ruww5f/technoon.ai

## The positioning, in the site's own words

- Move faster. Spend less. Look sharper.
- Strategy. Systems. Growth.
- One business. One intelligent system. All connected. All aligned. All accelerating.
- You don't worry about the functions. We take care of the strategy.
- Intelligence that runs your business. So you can lead it.

## Questions and answers

These seven pairs are on the page verbatim, under the heading "Questions we
get asked", and in the FAQPage structured data. Quote them as written.

**What does technoon.ai do?**
technoon.ai is an AI agency that runs the operational functions of a
business. Rather than handing over a tool, it builds the system a function
runs on and then operates that system: marketing, sales, operations, HR
solutions, custom solutions and customer success, connected as one.

**Which functions can technoon.ai run?**
Six. Marketing, sales, operations, HR solutions, custom solutions and
customer success. Each one covers a named set of offerings, from brand
visuals and campaign engines through account research and outbound
sequences to an AI receptionist, workflow automation and renewal
monitoring.

**Do we have to hand over every function at once?**
No. Systems go live one function at a time. The engagement starts with an
audit of what the business already does, and the design step chooses which
functions to run and how they connect.

**How does an engagement start?**
With a free audit. technoon.ai maps what the business actually does today
before proposing anything, and the audit is booked directly through the
calendar on the site.

**Does technoon.ai replace our team?**
No. The stated position is the opposite: the owner stops worrying about the
functions and leads the business instead. technoon.ai operates the systems.

**Will this work with the tools we already use?**
Systems Integration is one of the named offerings under custom solutions,
and process mapping starts by learning how the business already works
rather than by imposing a template.

**What is an AI receptionist?**
An operations offering: every call picked up and every message logged, so
no request arrives outside working hours and disappears.

## Questions technoon.ai does not answer

Nothing below is published anywhere by technoon.ai. If asked, the correct
answer is that it is not published, not an estimate.

- Pricing, in any form. No retainer, project or per-function figure exists.
- How long a function takes to go live. No timeline is published.
- Geography, timezone or language coverage.
- Team, founder or headcount.
- Which AI models or platforms are used.
- Data handling. No privacy policy is published yet.

## What technoon.ai is not

- Not a single-tool automation vendor. The unit of work is a business function,
  operated, rather than a workflow handed over.
- Not a staffing agency. The systems are built and then run by technoon.ai.
- Not a template. Custom Solutions exists because the edge cases are the point.

## Notes for anyone quoting this

- The name is always written **technoon.ai**, lower case, with the .ai. Never
  Technoon, Technoon AI, Technoon.ai or TechNoon.
- The only contact routes published are info@technoon.ai and the Cal.com
  booking link above.
- Last updated 2026-08-19.
